# OpenAI
> OpenAI builds AI models, APIs, and products for developers, businesses, and consumers.

OpenAI provides platform documentation for building with its APIs, product information for ChatGPT and enterprise offerings, research publications, safety resources, and company updates.

## Platform Documentation
- [Docs Home](https://platform.openai.com/docs): Main documentation hub for building with the OpenAI API.
- [Quickstart](https://platform.openai.com/docs/quickstart): Get started making your first API request.
- [API Reference](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference): Reference documentation for core API endpoints and objects.
- [Models](https://platform.openai.com/docs/models): Overview of available models and their capabilities.
- [Pricing](https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing): Pricing information for API models and platform usage.
- [Libraries](https://platform.openai.com/docs/libraries): Official and community SDKs for supported languages.
- [Changelog](https://platform.openai.com/docs/changelog): Product and API release notes for the platform.

## Guides
- [Text Generation](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/text-generation): Guide to generating and structuring text outputs.
- [Image Generation](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/image-generation): Guide to creating and editing images with models.
- [Vision](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/vision): Guide to using image inputs with multimodal models.
- [Audio](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/audio): Guide to speech, transcription, and audio generation workflows.
- [Function Calling](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/function-calling): Guide to calling tools and external functions from models.
- [Structured Outputs](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs): Guide to enforcing JSON schemas and structured responses.
- [Embeddings](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/embeddings): Guide to generating vector embeddings for search and retrieval.
- [Batch](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/batch): Guide to asynchronous bulk processing with batch jobs.

## Realtime and Agents
- [Realtime API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/realtime): Guide to low-latency multimodal realtime interactions.
- [Assistants API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/assistants): Guide to building assistant-style applications with tools.
- [Conversation State](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/conversation-state): Guide to managing context and state across interactions.
- [Tools](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools): Guide to using built-in and external tools with models.
- [Rate Limits](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/rate-limits): Guidance on platform rate limits and throughput planning.

## Safety and Best Practices
- [Safety Best Practices](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/safety-best-practices): Recommendations for safer application design and deployment.
- [Moderation](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/moderation): Guide to content moderation and safety classification.
- [Prompt Engineering](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/prompt-engineering): Techniques for improving reliability and output quality.
- [Production Best Practices](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/production-best-practices): Guidance for deploying reliable applications in production.
- [Error Codes](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/error-codes): Explanations of common API errors and troubleshooting steps.
- [Latency Optimization](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/latency-optimization): Techniques for reducing response times and improving performance.

## SDKs and Developer Resources
- [OpenAI Python](https://github.com/openai/openai-python): Official Python SDK for the OpenAI API.
- [OpenAI Node](https://github.com/openai/openai-node): Official JavaScript and TypeScript SDK for the OpenAI API.
- [OpenAI Cookbook](https://cookbook.openai.com/): Examples and recipes for common API use cases.
- [OpenAI Developers Collection](https://developers.openai.com/): Developer resources, examples, and announcements.
- [Platform Dashboard](https://platform.openai.com/): Developer console for API keys, usage, and settings.

## ChatGPT and Products
- [ChatGPT](https://openai.com/chatgpt/): Product overview for OpenAI’s conversational AI assistant.
- [ChatGPT Team](https://openai.com/chatgpt/team/): Collaboration-focused ChatGPT plan for teams and organizations.
- [ChatGPT Enterprise](https://openai.com/enterprise/): Enterprise offering with security, admin, and deployment controls.
- [ChatGPT Edu](https://openai.com/chatgpt/education/): ChatGPT offering tailored for educational institutions.
- [Sora](https://openai.com/sora/): OpenAI’s video generation product and research showcase.
- [API Platform](https://openai.com/api/): Overview of OpenAI’s developer platform and API offering.

## Research
- [Research Index](https://openai.com/research/): Hub for OpenAI research publications and technical work.
- [GPT-4](https://openai.com/research/gpt-4): Research page describing GPT-4 capabilities and evaluations.
- [GPT-4o](https://openai.com/index/hello-gpt-4o/): Introduction to GPT-4o and multimodal capabilities.
- [DALL·E 3](https://openai.com/research/dall-e-3): Research page for the DALL·E 3 image generation model.
- [Sora Research](https://openai.com/research/video-generation-models-as-world-simulators/): Research article on video generation models and world simulation.
- [Whisper](https://openai.com/research/whisper): Research page for the Whisper speech recognition model.

## Safety, Security, and Governance
- [Safety](https://openai.com/safety/): Overview of OpenAI’s approach to safety and responsible deployment.
- [Security & Privacy](https://openai.com/security-and-privacy/): Information on security practices, privacy, and data protection.
- [Preparedness Framework](https://openai.com/index/preparedness-framework/): Framework for evaluating and managing frontier model risks.
- [Usage Policies](https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies/): Rules governing acceptable use of OpenAI services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/): Policy describing how OpenAI collects and uses personal data.
- [Terms of Use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/): Terms governing consumer use of OpenAI services.

## News and Company
- [News](https://openai.com/news/): Company announcements, launches, and organizational updates.
- [Blog](https://openai.com/blog/): Articles about products, research, and company perspectives.
- [About](https://openai.com/about/): Overview of OpenAI’s mission, structure, and leadership.
- [Careers](https://openai.com/careers/): Open roles and information about working at OpenAI.
- [OpenAI for Business](https://openai.com/business/): Overview of business solutions and enterprise adoption.
- [Contact Sales](https://openai.com/contact-sales/): Contact page for enterprise and business inquiries.
